how_to_count: Games: our_code main or v31, map not queen_spawn_dead_end (join on map_key). Lone queen of side s = queen (lowest initial id of the side) at a turnStart of hers when the other side's queen is already dead (her death event already seen). Part A (all lone turns): at the start of each such turn count the dragons of the OTHER side alive with body length 4 or less (short), and those whose head is within 12 path steps of her head (breadth-first over tiles, a kelp edge blocks, a portal edge leads to the paired edge's far tile, ordinary steps wrap, dragon bodies ignored). Report per code: mean short alive per turn for each side, and sum(within 12)/sum(short alive) for each side, the ratio ours/theirs; with and without Portals #1; full games (last_round 499); before and from grow_round (raw round 151 if width*height > 1200 else 301); layouts above and at or under 1200 cells. Part B (lone turns with raw round >= 100, Portals #1 left out): seen = at the turn start some head of the other side is within 3 columns and 3 rows (wrapped, Chebyshev 3) of any tile of her body; fresh = seen at this or one of her earlier lone turn starts with round difference <= 20 (sightings before round 100 but after she became lone count). Report share of turns fresh for each side, share of turns with no sighting yet since she became lone, and mean short dragons of the other side within 12 path steps at fresh turns and at stale turns. My scripts: work/h20_pass.py + h20_count.py (part A), work/h21_pass.py + h21_count.py (part B). Known approximation to judge: 'seen' is tested only at the queen's own turn starts, not at each of the other side's turn starts.

how_to_count: Games: our_code main or v31, map not queen_spawn_dead_end. Open sides of a tile = its four edges that are not kelp (a portal edge is open); narrow = two or fewer open sides; neighbours follow portals and wrap. Chance = a turnStart of a queen whose head tile has three or more open sides and at least one neighbour tile that is narrow. Entered = at her next turnStart (or at the end of the game) she is alive and her head is on a narrow tile; a turn in which she dies is not an entry. Window by the raw round of the chance: r0-100, r101-200. Pearl part: pearls present from tileChange events; an entry 'onto a pearl' = the narrow tile she ends on is a neighbour that had no dragon body and held a pearl at the turn start; 'pearl chance' = a chance where some narrow neighbour without a body held a pearl. Stay = consecutive queen turn starts on narrow tiles, begun at the first such turn start after one on a non-narrow tile (or at spawn), assigned to the window of its first turn; report queen turn starts per stay and stays that end with her death. My scripts: work/h20_pass.py + h20_count.py.
